title: Add video keyframe pipeline

context.summary: Add a video keyframe processing path that creates derived frame artifacts and searchable frame descriptions with configurable max keyframes.
context.background: TASK-44 added image semantic artifacts and TASK-46 added modality extractors with fallback manifests. Video routing still skips because no processor exists.

in: Route enabled video uploads to document.extract.
Add a dedicated video keyframe extractor with deterministic embedded-manifest fallback behavior.
Create video_keyframe derived artifacts and keyframe description spans.
Propagate keyframe artifact refs into chunk metadata and search source refs.
Index fallback video duration, codec and frame count metadata when available.
Add integration coverage for video upload, keyframe cap and frame phrase search.
Update docs, validators and workspace wiring.
out: Running real image/OCR/face model adapters on frames.

acceptance_criteria: Enabled video routing creates a document.extract job.
Video extraction writes no more than the configured max keyframe artifacts.
Keyframe artifacts include frame index and timestamp source positions.
Chunk metadata/source refs include keyframe artifacts.
Video document search returns source-backed hits for keyframe descriptions.
Video metadata filters can use fallback duration and frame count when present.

manual_checks: Confirm video search hits include keyframe artifact metadata.

risks: The MVP video extractor uses an embedded manifest fallback until a real ffmpeg/local model adapter is installed.
Frame descriptions are derived text, not stored bitmap keyframes yet.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
